name: Empowered Professionals of Tomorrow (UVU)
what_you_do: Take real college classes at UVU for seven weeks in the summer. Pick a track in science, engineering, education or business. You earn college credit and meet mentors.
who_can_apply: Utah high school students in grades 9 to 11. The page says it is especially for first-generation college learners.
pay_detail: No pay. Tuition is free for admitted students. You pay for your own rides, lunches and personal costs.
duration: 7 weeks. Tuesdays to Thursdays, 9:00 AM to 3:15 PM (June 24 to Aug 7; the page names no year)
deadline_text: The 2027 application window opens Nov 20, 2026. A closing date is not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Share your interests, your goals and why you want to join. The application asks for short written responses, which carry strong weight. The team picks students by readiness, interest and fit.
notes: You must go in person. Classes also have homework outside class time. Track choice is not guaranteed. Questions: text 801-928-7615. You can join a contact list for notices.
